Metadata.Title: Happy Dungeons
Metadata.Name: Local server: redirect Toylogic hosts to 127.0.0.1:5100
Metadata.Author: local
Metadata.Note: Points the game's hard-coded Toylogic URLs (Vulcan delivery API, telemetry, Lynca dev API, legal page) at a local server so it never contacts the real hosts. PSN features go through shadNet; set its server to 127.0.0.1 in config.json.

Metadata.Title: Happy Dungeons
Metadata.Name: Saves: empty cloud slot means "no save yet", not "corrupt"
Metadata.Author: local
Metadata.Note: The game's save loader (eboot 0x9db590) only treats sceNpTusGetDataA error 0x8055084A (user storage data not found) as 'no saved game'. shadNet answers an unset TUS slot with success and 0 bytes, so a fresh account got 'The saved game is corrupt'. This makes a 0-byte read take the not-found path (result 4) like real PSN; other errors still give result 2.

Metadata.Title: Happy Dungeons
Metadata.Name: Network: treat the NAT check as done (lobby countdown stuck at 29)
Metadata.Author: local
Metadata.Note: shadPS4 always answers sceNetCtlGetNatInfo with STUN status 0 (not checked) and NAT type 0, so the game's NAT state machine (eboot 0x8754e0) retries every frame, its network manager never becomes ready, and the lobby countdown freezes at 29 before failing with a network error. This reports STUN OK / NAT type 2 (moderate) when the emulator leaves them at 0. Caves at eboot 0x27ae200 and 0x27ae280.

Metadata.Title: Happy Dungeons
Metadata.Name: Network: select() checks the game's socket (online co-op)
Metadata.Author: local
Metadata.Note: The game calls select() with nfds = 0, which the PS4 ignores but shadPS4 honours, so its peer-to-peer socket never looks writable and the game never sends anything to other players (lobby shows them without a character, then 'continuous communication cannot be maintained'). This passes nfds = fd + 1. eboot 0x8efd37, cave 0x27ae300.
